description: This file implements process information handling, including process memory stats, process enumeration, and platform-specific process name retrieval, within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Represents a process, providing methods to retrieve process details, memory usage, command line, and process hierarchy.

classes.name: ProcessInfo::Memory
classes.description: Holds memory usage statistics for a process, including USS, PSS, RSS, VSS, and shared memory.

classes.name: ProcessCurrent
classes.description: Provides static methods related to the current process, such as user and group management.

classes.name: ProcessTree
classes.description: Represents a hierarchy of processes, allowing enumeration of child processes and process IDs.

methods.name: ExecutableName
methods.description: Retrieves the executable path or name for a given process handle or PID, platform-specific.

methods.name: ProcessName
methods.description: Retrieves the process path for a given PID on Apple platforms.

methods.name: FindChildren
methods.description: Finds child processes of a given process ID based on acceptance criteria.

methods.name: FindPid
methods.description: Finds process IDs matching a given process name, with optional exact match.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Iterator
methods.description: Iterator class for enumerating processes, including all, children, or by name.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Allocated
methods.description: Returns the allocated memory size of the process.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Resident
methods.description: Returns the resident memory size of the process.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Shared
methods.description: Returns the shared memory size of the process.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Name
methods.description: Returns the executable name of the process.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Executable
methods.description: Returns the full executable path of the process.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::CommandLine
methods.description: Returns the command line arguments of the process (Linux-specific).

methods.name: ProcessCurrent::User
methods.description: Returns the username of the current process user.

methods.name: ProcessCurrent::User (setter)
methods.description: Sets the user ID of the current process to the specified username.

methods.name: ProcessCurrent::Group
methods.description: Returns the group name of the current process user.

methods.name: ProcessCurrent::Group (setter)
methods.description: Sets the group ID of the current process to the specified group name.

methods.name: ProcessTree::ContainsProcess
methods.description: Checks if a process with a specific thread ID exists in the process tree.

methods.name: ProcessTree::GetProcessIds
methods.description: Retrieves all process IDs in the process tree.

methods.name: ProcessTree::RootId
methods.description: Returns the root process ID of the process tree.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Memory::MemoryStats
methods.description: Populates memory statistics for the process by reading /proc/<pid>/smaps.
